provenance.command: cd apps/mobile && MINDWTR_CAPTURE_NOTIFICATIONS_SETTINGS=1 TZ=UTC bunx vitest run components/settings/notifications-settings-screen.parity.test.tsx
provenance.sourceState: Every file under apps/mobile and packages/core was at dba1097c7 except this harness: React Native's screen still held its own policy, and core had no notifications settings model.
provenance.device: The device is stubbed: Platform.OS, the notification permission answer, the exact-alarm state, the persistent capture switch and the system locale are the scenario's device; Android unless it says iOS.

scenarios.name: reminders on: every switch off and on
master switch off: only start and due reminders dim
exact alarms denied: the notice follows any notification feature
exact alarms not asked on this Android
in German, dates follow the system locale
in English on a German phone
iOS: no capture switch, spinner time pickers
